auditHierarchy: exact lesson occurrence and lesson/makeup lane

weekContract.configuration: Monday is the documented default and the only supported v1 start; changing the convention requires an explicit contract extension
weekContract.selector: weekStart: YYYY-MM-DD that is a Monday in the lesson-local calendar
weekContract.crossMonthYear: The same week may include dates from two months or two years; the key is the actual Monday date plus time zone
weekContract.arithmetic: UTC date methods are used only for Gregorian calendar arithmetic, never to convert source timestamps or foreign-zone lessons

queryContract.asOfDate: Explicit local calendar date used only to label historical/current/future weeks
queryContract.timeZone: Required for projectLearningWeeks, optional on compatibility filters; foreign zones remain unresolved before temporal comparisons
queryContract.intersection: weekStart AND month AND day AND local time AND student AND edition; contradictory exact selectors yield no matches in the core selector
queryContract.unresolved: selectLearningEntries and projectLearningWeeks retain uncertain filter matches; filterLearningEntries and projectLearningTimeline keep their matched-only compatibility behavior

identityAndProvenance.sourcePlanSeparation: Each edition group has separate sourceFacts and teacherPlans containing original entityId/revisionId/recordedAt/entry
identityAndProvenance.unknownLesson: Unverified source joins or unknown occurrence keys are isolated by entity, never joined on student/date/name alone
identityAndProvenance.unknownEdition: An unknown edition gets its own entity group instead of a shared unknown book
identityAndProvenance.makeup: Regular and makeup compatibility lanes remain separate even when an input reuses an occurrence string
identityAndProvenance.originalScope: Every row retains the original ContentScope and evidence references so the shared catalog can resolve the deeper hierarchy without copying it
identityAndProvenance.latestOnly: Current grouping uses validated currentRevisions; full history remains unchanged for retrospective audit

noInference: A historical approved plan is still an approved plan, not proof of work
Current/future weekly labels do not imply attendance or completion
An observed source timestamp does not set the lesson week
No foreign-zone conversion or missing date/time is guessed
No live source join, pagination completeness, persistence or deployment is certified
acceptanceCoverage: Foreign-zone and unknown exact filter matches
Week to lesson to edition envelope grouping
Unknown source joins and editions isolated
Latest revision and original history preservation

deployment.environment: Offline synthetic code/tests and separately verified private Google Drive development only
deployment.production: No testing or preview writes to the staff-visible operational workbook; exact final target and final deployment approval still required
deployment.v1Artifact: The prior private Drive review ZIP remains a valid earlier milestone, not the latest weekly implementation
